abs_progressive_braking.definition: Applying the brake with steadily increasing pressure instead of one sudden push.
abs_progressive_braking.example: In heavy traffic she used progressive braking and the stop was smooth.

advance_fee.definition: Money demanded before a service is delivered. Common in fake job offers, fake investments and fake love interests.
advance_fee.example: They wanted a small fee before the equipment arrived, and then a larger one.

base_year.definition: The year the price index starts from, set to 100. Changing it resets the index without changing any actual prices.
base_year.example: With last year as the base year, the index now stands at 104.

bc_menopause.definition: The point at which ovulation and menstruation stop.
bc_menopause.example: Menopause is a biological event, not a date on a calendar.

inflation_rate.definition: The percentage change in the general level of prices over a period of time, usually a year.
inflation_rate.example: The annual inflation rate was 4 %, so prices rose 4 % on average.

nominal_income.definition: Income measured in the money actually received, with no adjustment for changes in prices.
nominal_income.example: My nominal income rose, but not as fast as prices.
